Title: Suresh and the Family

Cast

1. Suresh - 34 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Anjali - 32 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Neeta - 57 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Karan - 66 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
4. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Suresh stands on the road. Neeta and Karan stand near him.]

Neeta: "What lovely weather!"

[Suresh's car crashes into a pole.]

Suresh: "I knew it!"

[A dog runs in front of Suresh's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Suresh: "I knew it!"

[Suresh loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Suresh: "Exactly right."

Scene 2: The road - Day

Neeta: "Let's begin."

[Suresh rides his motorbike to the market.]

Suresh: "Hey, look at that!"

[Suresh starts his scooter and rides off.]

Karan: "What next?"

[Suresh drives the car to the office.]

Suresh (softly): "And then?"

[Suresh gets out of the car.]

Neeta: "I'm ready!"

[Suresh rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Neeta (gently): "Really?"

[Suresh takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Suresh: "Oh wow!"

Scene 3: The kitchen - Day

Karan: "So, here we are!"

[Anjali rolls out rotis on the board.]

Anjali: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Anjali stirs the dal in the pot.]

Anjali (happily): "Okay, Dad."

Scene 4: The living room - Day

Karan: "Suresh, look over here."

[Suresh pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Suresh: "One more time!"

[Suresh drinks a beer.]

Suresh: "Yes, of course."

[Suresh staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Suresh: "That was such a fun day!"
